script_parts.opening: Namaskar, Vaan Polyplast ji — main IndiaMART se bol raha hoon. Mujhe aapka account dekh ke thoda concern hua kyunki pichle poore 30 dinon mein aapka platform pe ek bhi active day nahi raha aur enquiries bhi zero hain — toh seedha aapse baat karna zaroori laga.
script_parts.diagnostic: Bhai, main samajhna chahta hoon — kya aapko lag raha hai ki jo products aapne list kiye hain unke buyers is platform pe aa hi nahi rahe, ya phir leads aa rahi thin lekin quality itni kharab thi ki aapne platform check karna hi band kar diya?
script_parts.value_demo: Ek important cheez share karta hoon — aapka CQS score abhi 59 hai, jo 60 ke threshold se neeche hai, iska matlab aapki listings search results mein significantly kam dikhai de rahi hain; aur is waqt aapke segment mein demand tier 'Red' hai matlab market mein buyers ka volume low hai — toh dono cheezein ek saath kaam kar rahi hain aapke against.
script_parts.action: Toh bhai, abhi is call pe hi ek kaam karte hain — main aapka catalog open karta hoon aur hum milke dekhte hain ki CQS 59 se 60+ karne ke liye konsi 2-3 specific fields — jaise product description, image, ya minimum order quantity — update karni hain, yeh 10 minute ka kaam hai aur search visibility turant improve hoti hai.
script_parts.close: Aaj hum yeh ek CQS fix kar lete hain; phir agle 15 dinon mein agar lead flow start nahi hota toh main personally aapko call karke next step discuss karunga — koi pressure nahi, bas ek data point lenge ki platform kaam kar raha hai ya nahi. Theek hai ji?

script_parts_en.opening: Hello, Vaan Polyplast ji — I'm calling from IndiaMART. I noticed that over the last 30 days your account has had zero active days and zero enquiries, which is a clear signal that something needs to be addressed, so I wanted to speak with you directly.
script_parts_en.diagnostic: I want to understand the root cause — do you feel that buyers for your products simply aren't coming to this platform, or was it that the lead quality was so poor at some point that you stopped checking the platform altogether?
script_parts_en.value_demo: Here's a concrete data point: your CQS score is currently 59, just below the 60 threshold, which means your listings are getting significantly reduced visibility in search results; on top of that, your demand tier is 'Red' right now, meaning overall buyer volume in your segment is low — so both visibility and market demand are working against you simultaneously.
script_parts_en.action: Let's do one specific thing right now on this call — I'll pull up your catalog and together we'll identify 2-3 fields, such as product description, images, or minimum order quantity, that we can update to push your CQS above 60; this is a 10-minute fix that directly improves your search ranking.
script_parts_en.close: Let's get this CQS fix done today; then if lead flow doesn't improve in the next 15 days, I'll personally call you back to discuss the next step — no pressure, we'll just have a real data point to work with. Does that work for you, ji?

objection_handlers.competitor_platform: Samajh sakta hoon — doosre platforms bhi kaam karte hain. Lekin IndiaMART pe B2B buyers specifically aate hain jo bulk order dene ka intent rakhte hain. Ek baar compare karte hain — aapke last 3 mahine ke leads ka source kya raha?
objection_handlers.price_too_high: Bilkul valid point hai. Lekin aise socho — agar sirf 2 orders extra aaye subscription se, toh ROI positive ho jaata hai. Main aapke category ke average order value se calculate kar sakta hoon.
objection_handlers.no_time: Koi baat nahi — main ek quick summary WhatsApp pe bhej deta hoon. Aap apne time pe dekh lena, aur jo bhi question ho directly reply karna.

objection_handlers_en.competitor_platform: I understand — other platforms work too. But IndiaMART specifically attracts B2B buyers who intend to place bulk orders. Let's compare — what was the source of your leads over the last 3 months?
objection_handlers_en.price_too_high: Completely valid point. But think of it this way — if just 2 extra orders come through the subscription, the ROI turns positive. I can calculate that using your category's average order value.
objection_handlers_en.no_time: No problem — I'll send you a quick summary on WhatsApp. Check it at your convenience, and just reply directly with any questions.
